englishText: I think I can spot and Avian plushie sticking out of the top.

Is this like one o' them ''free for the taking'' boxes?
An eye-catching arcade sign.
This arcade sign demands to be stared at.
Ooh, an arcade run by Penguins! What could possibly go wrong?
This arcade sign isn't exactly understated, but it has charm.
Those rowdy birds rounded up themselves an arcade.
It's a bold move, to advertise that this place is run by Penguins.
This is about as fancy as a Penguin's fashion sense can be.
Severed head of tiny bird iss adorned with silly bowtie.
Jesting. The bowtie compliments the suit-like pattern of Penguins rather well!
Looks like a very classy penguin.
Does this sign serve as a warning, or as mere advertisement?
Sure looks like a fancy little Penguin.
I'm not sure, if I would like to rest on a hybrid between a Hylotl and a bear.
Fishman plushie ate too much.
Tempted. A commercial product of a cute character from a children's cartoon.
I may be tired of seeing Numi everywhere in the cities, but this is not the place I need for a rest from Numi...
Too cute and weird-feelin' for my taste.
This must be as separate branch of the Beakeasy bar.
Does this mean that all the arcade machines are Penguin-sized?
Hopeful. Maybe they have a better stock of arcade machines than the drinks at the Beakeasy bar.
If they don't have one of those pinball machines with Penguin-like flippers at the bottom, I'll be mildly disppointend.
I wonder, if they purchased arcade machines from Hylotl manufacturers.
Those rowdy birds have got themselves an arcade now.
Stylish. Only the Penguins could think of making furniture like this.
What an oddly stylish Penguin chair!
Sssoft leather chair shaped like stubby little birdss!
Envious. This chair is most delightfully comical.
That's a pretty cool chair. So the Penguins ARE capable of style!
This chair has an unusually introcate design, for a chair that has been made by Penguins.
An almost life-sized trophy of a Penguin. A strangely valuable trinket for patrons.
I'm surprised that this trophy isn't made of cheap plastic. These Penguins are full of surprises...
Baffled. This trophy is actually made of gold. Its size as well as the finish are most impressive!
I feel so accomplished with this trophy by my side! Boy, that must've cost a lot of money though...
This golden trophy may hold as much value as the amount of money it took to get a hold of it.
This dog seems like a good companion to lay down and relax with.
It appears to be a dog from Earth. A cute one!
Floran hasss never seen any beasst like thiss!
Crying. It is unbearingly cute.
Cute doggy! I wonder why I haven't seen any in Space...
Do dogs like bacon? Askin' for a little friend.
I can create arcade equipment here.
It's a workstation for crafting equipment to use for arcades.
Floran can make equipment for game thingsss.
Pleased. A workstation for creating arcade related equipment. Very handy.
Arcade related equipment can be crafted on this workstation. Neat!
For arcade tools and accessories, this is the go to workstation.
This looks like the typical advert in front of a fast food diner. Apart from the perching penguin.
It does feel somewhat tempting to perch up on this flashy sign...
Floran will have trouble ssneaking into fast food building becaussse of sstubby little look-out.
Confused. This business appears to be accepting outdated currency.
That penguin really made itself comfortble up on these signs.
This sign looks about as impressive as I imagined...
Since when did these fast food joints hire their own lookouts?
The drinks sold here could provide some necessary hydration, if they actually contain any water.
This machine looks like it can dispense drinks, and appears to be in working order.
Ssspace sssugar water!
Disinterested. The drinks sold by this fountain have low hydrating properties. The main appeal seems to be the taste.
What luck having this soda fountain here, I'm feeling like I lack a little sugar!
It's like a pixel-swallowin' water pump, that spews out fizzy drinks. Actually, ain't nothin' like a real water pump...
The sauce used on some burgers can make my feathers sticky. It's a meal best enjoyed carefully...
Floran looking forward to burgerss with meat bunsss!
Indifferent. This sign flickers in a simple, somewhat gaze-catching pattern.
I do hope the burgers aren't just as neon as the sign.
This place appears to offer simple dishes. Simplicity does have its appeal, occasionally.
I'll be darned, if these folks actually offer glowing brurgers.
Very mysterious and shadowy, hm...
Ssspooky man.
Curious. A race like this doesn't exist in my databanks, odd.
Hey, isn't this that strange guy that just hangs around telling people they are unworthy?
I do not know who this plushie is representing. Curious.
I have a fondness for people like this, though he sure does look like an outlaw.
An adorable little plush of a bee.
I'm wondering how high they have ever flown up in the sky.
Floran's heart feelsss funny when looking at thiss.
Eager. I have heard that they are quite exceptional at swordsmanship!
I am getting some rather dodgy deja-vu, looking at this plushie...

Why does the tag on this thing read ''9''?
The aura this thing gives is... interesting.

The strongest.
Who is this sassy lost plushie?

That's nice glasses ya have, mate.
The man who would gladly trade even his own life to save his sister.
He ssstab. Absssolute perfection~
Torn. I guess so long as you protect even the last remnant of your family, you have a good soul... right?
I preferred his Father counterpart, but oh well he did grow a pair later on.
He seemed to be fighting for the greator good.
Definitely don't wanna end up on his bad side, least if I don't plan on bringin' a gun along.
He did all that for a bunny?
If I had a pixel for every time a human was blessed by Kluex, I'd have two pixels, which isn't much but it's weird that it happened twice.
Besst Human warrior of all, hope Floran can be as strong someday.
Interested. Humans are usually neither as strong or as durable as this particular individual.
How much do I have to kill to make all of Hell fear me like that?

Some kind of a toy robot.
Let's pray this toy doesn't have built-in flamethrowers.
Floran can't trussst thisss fake metal man.
Confused. Is this a modified Glitch of sorts? It looks rather unusual.

Holy smokes! I thought this doll had a livin' brain!
This little Floran is equipped with equally small sewing tools. I wouldn't be surprised, if they used the sewing needle for stabbing prey.
It looks like this Floran is equipped with a sewing kit. I wonder what kind of tapestries they would make...
Floran friend! Where is hisss hunting equipment though?
Kindled. This Floran decided to spend his time developing skills other than hunting, such as sewing.
It's nice to see a Floran get accustomed to a different lifestyle!
Never seen a Floran like him, but I'd bet he has the handiwork to make all sorts of clothin'!

This plushie depicts a formidable warrior from a distant land, with striking features and a fierce determination in her eyes. To the rebels, she represents a symbol of resistance against the Miniknog.

This plushie portrays a valiant hero of the past who braved countless dangers to protect her homeland. A true symbol of strength and courage, it was said she would always do what's right, even in the face of danger.
Sssilly human fightsss with a ssstick! Whack whack whack!

Awe. This plushie depicts a heroic figure from a long-forgotten medieval era who defended her country against all threats, both internal and external. Many Glitch regard her as a symbol of free will and individuality.

This marketable plush honours the memory of a legendary explorer who rose up against tyranny and oppression, fighting for justice and inspiring others to join her cause. Humans have long looked up to her as a symbol of courage and hope in dark times.
This plushie embodies the spirit of a revered figure from a distant land, known for her wisdom and diplomatic skills. Her graceful movements and flowing garments are a perfect match for the Hylotl.
This plushie's a tribute to a legendary explorer, whose exploits and bravery are the stuff of legends. Supposedly she was a real wizard when it came to brewin'!
It looks... incredibly tired.
It looks like it needs a nap.
Ssssleepy stuffed toy.
Confused. Why is it tired looking?
I think he needs a cup of coffee.
Is there some poetic meaning behind this toy's tired expression?
I don't really know what t'say about this toy. It looks like it needs a good night's sleep.
An axolotl with pyrokinetic abilities? That would explain the burn marks shown on this plush toy.

They'd probably plunder wagons on dirt roads, rather than hovercars on an actual highway.
This small highwayman has a fierce gaze by default, it seems.
I vish all those damned highvaymen vere this small! It'd be much easier to take care o' theim.

The snugget loves this one.
The primordial beings as stuffed toys? Well, that's a... erm... unusual idea.

Uneasy. How did they replicate a precursor so well?
Hey, wasn't there a guy who wrote about spooky tentacled things like this one?
Sadly, according to historians, the real K'Rakoths were not as cuddly.
She will fit nicely on my bookshelf.
Glowing girl ssseeks ancient sssecretss.
Amused. This plushie has a tiny book in its pocket.
I assume this is supposed to be Libra Eclipse, the current leader of the Relic Seekers.
An adorable lil' bookworm.
To my knowledge, the origin of this creature is a mystery.
Funny jelly thingy.

Curious. I wonder who made Lumoths to begin with?

Cute, felted, and bright. Useful and adorable.

Like Kluex to my people, she's worshipped by literal cats as a goddess.

Oh what else did I expect from a game about cats? ... Invading everything.
Presumably this person is closer to being a counterpart of Crazy Cat Lady...
Interesting, this plush seems to have four arms, a useful trait if needing to wield many things.
Creepy plush has four armssss, Floran sssstab it.
Observative. This plush has four arms and pleasantly fluffy fur.
It's Munch, the adorable trickster from the TV show ''Bounding from the Stars''.
I know a smart guy when I see one, this is one smart guy.
Quite expressive for a robot, much more than the Glitch at least.
Floran not know thisss robot man.

Man, I would like to meet one o' these guys, we must have an awful lot in common.

Why would an organization as respectable and peaceful as the Protectorate need armour like this?
I don't remember seeing any Protectors wearing armour like this here plushie.
These law enforcement officers seem nicer than the Miniknog at least.
What a cute guard! Many of them are so scary...
Floran wondersss what tiny gun can do.

Isss spiky friend.

How cute! A happy pineapple!
The sweetness of a pineapple captured in plushie form. It’s so soft!
Why’s the pineapple got eyes?

Who isss cat persson?

I love these kinds of people, always lookin' for more hazardous things to chase.
He employed similar tactics as our troops do in his lifetime. Great at stealth.

Floran feelss confident when looking at this plushie!
Confident. This small warrior gives off a contageous sense of confidence!
